direct_source_facts: The retained donor now contains a primitive that validates one exact canonical JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet and requires that packet wire to occur exactly once in the exact executor-consumed input bytes.
The primitive recomputes executor input SHA-256 and size from the consumed bytes and binds generation, Entry event/admission, route, GRID10, cell, role, basis, executor and invocation identity.
The observed VerifiedModelExecution/v1 schema still carries input_sha256/input_size but does not carry an HCU_MODEL_INPUT_CONTROL_BINDING/v1 identity.
The observed HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v4 schema echoes VerifiedModelExecution input identity but likewise carries no model-input-control-binding identity.

Therefore existence of the new primitive does not yet make Vector-Control consumption transitive through ModelExecution -> InferenceReceipt -> JSpaceBinding; without explicit integration, the primitive can remain an unconsumed side proof.

hypothesis: If the exact ModelInputControlBinding identity is admitted at the same executor invocation boundary and then echoed/cross-bound through VerifiedModelExecution, InferenceReceipt and JSpaceBinding, the source chain can distinguish exact control-consumption provenance from a merely adjacent standalone control proof.
counterhypothesis: Keeping the ModelInputControlBinding as a standalone validated object is sufficient because matching input_sha256/input_size elsewhere implicitly connects it to the same invocation.
counterhypothesis_result: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_SCOPE: no currently observed downstream schema requires the standalone binding identity, so equal input digest fields do not prove that downstream admission actually consumed or validated that control-binding object.

next_patch_contract.single_authority: extend existing ModelExecution/Inference/JSpace causal spine; do not create a second inference or truth authority
required_edges: executor invocation admission must produce or externally admit one exact HCU_MODEL_INPUT_CONTROL_BINDING/v1 for the same executor_id + invocation_id
VerifiedModelExecution must bind the control-binding digest plus exact input_sha256/input_size and generation/GRID/cell/role identity
InferenceReceipt must derive/echo that admitted control-binding identity from VerifiedModelExecution rather than accept a caller assertion
JspaceInferenceBinding must cross-bind the same control-binding identity to TrainingTrace.vector_control_packet_sha256 and inference input identity
tampered binding, wrong invocation, wrong input digest/size, wrong packet, wrong generation/GRID/cell/role or missing binding must fail closed for control-consumption credit
next_patch_contract.credit_boundary: Association-only J-Space component evidence may remain valid; J-Space control-consumption/model-runtime credit remains zero until admitted exact execution proves the integrated path.
